main.description: LangGraph multi-step image curation. Input is the full Mapillary candidate set; output is 20-40 selected image IDs ordered by SfM utility. Nodes: score_quality (heuristic resolution + blur EXIF) → score_coverage (azimuthal + baseline diversity) → llm_dedupe (Murakumo Vision LLM near-dup collapse) → decide_count. Selected count caps COLMAP memory at ~16 GiB on a single CPU pod.

targetCount.description: Soft target for selected image count. Default 30.

minCount.description: Below this, mark tile as unreconstructable. Default 8.

selectedIds.description: Mapillary image IDs picked for COLMAP, ordered by descending utility.

abort.description: True if minCount not met; downstream tasks must short-circuit.
